tasks.title: Asset-backed dynamic layout repair
tasks.contract: Pass verified narration assets through candidate validation and publication; check dynamic captions/state on every frame; no content/timing changes. Normalize local MP3/FLAC/Vorbis/Opus/PCM in a kernel-isolated decoder to existing verified WAV contracts; explicit sample-offset mixing rejects clipping and preserves an input/output transformation manifest.

tasks.title: Specialized reduced-motion milestones
tasks.contract: Explicit source-bound discrete milestones for existing camera/equation/graph consumers; preserve required equation states and full graph; no learning-equivalence claims. Add explicit equal-outline affine glyph correspondences; no mathematical equivalence inference.

tasks.title: Installed toolchain identity
tasks.contract: Manifest every installed dependency file and internal symlink; exact lockfile/version binding; Node/browser/native assets and immutable replay checks.

tasks.title: Operational Linux isolation
tasks.contract: Private user/mount/PID/network namespaces; read-only system/engine mounts, private writable workspace, no-new-privileges/syscall restrictions, resource limits and lock-based concurrency. Adopt the same kernel worker for checked-source Mathtext and audio decoding. Browser procfs profile remains distinct from the no-proc compiler profile.

tasks.title: Actual Remotion measurement producer
tasks.contract: Pinned real renderer path, frame-indexed DOM measurements and image artifacts from the same execution, with no caller-receipt acceptance and no simulated fallback.

tasks.title: Paint/visibility QA
tasks.contract: Exhaustive source/frame identity, text contrast/occlusion/clip diagnostics, font and visual checks, explicit unsupported-case blockers and measured test fixtures. Installed Fontconfig/FreeType glyph coverage for declared system stacks, vector-ink envelopes and opaque-overlay tests; not universal raster segmentation or shaping/teaching assessment.

tasks.title: Render gate integration
tasks.contract: Connect private runner, toolchain snapshots, real evidence and source revalidation in existing real-render path; retain explicit local diagnostic mode.

tasks.title: Consolidated closure/re-audit
tasks.contract: Requirement-linked scope register, adversarial cross-component regressions, exact execution blockers and full section re-audit; no acceptance without evidence.
